items:
La Pointe is a classic beach home tucked away in the popular Grove By The Sea Neighborhood. With a private pool (plus the option to heat) and an easy walk to the beach, this Seagrove home will make the perfect 30A vacation.

With 3-bedrooms, 3-bathrooms and sleeps up to 9 guests, There's plenty of room across the main living area to relax with family. This home is meant for entertaining. Enjoy your favorite shows with Hulu Live TV for an enhanced viewing experience, dine indoors or out with plenty of options suited for formal dinners or a casual lunch. The 1st floor also includes a convenient queen bedroom and 2nd bedroom with queen bunks with trundle bed. The master bedroom is upstairs, as well as the laundry room. With 3-bedrooms, 3-bathrooms, and sleeping up to 9 guests, everyone can unwind in comfort.

Grab some fresh air on the wraparound screened-in porch, or soak up the sunshine lounging at your own private pool. Relax while you grill up some delicious barbeque and watch your family splash their cares away in the cool water. Head up to the private balcony upstairs for a bird's eye view of the neighborhood. Part of the balcony is screened in and the other part is open air.

Sleeping Arrangements:
1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combination.
1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bunk bed with twin pull-out trundle, TV.
2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, twin daybed with a twin pull-out trundle, TV and desk. Private bathroom with tub, dual vanity and separate shower. Private balcony access with additional seating.

Beach Access:
Head down N. Andalusia Ave. and follow this road across 30A and you’ll find your beach access.
Distance: .3 miles | Time: 7 minutes walking

Grove By The Sea:
As its name implies, The Grove by the Sea neighborhood is a peaceful, tree-lined community located directly across from the beautiful emerald beaches of South Walton. Beach access is an easy walk from the home, and there are 2 private neighborhood pools, plus a tennis court. Its proximity to nearby beach villages Seaside, Watercolor, Grayton Watersound, Alys and Rosemary make it an ideal location for all that 30A has to offer.

Your stay at La Pointe comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!

* Parking for 2 cars
* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee
* Sorry, no pets allowed

A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Discover the area's water adventures with scuba diving and snorkeling nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling and hiking/biking trails.

reviews.label: Good

responses.response: Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We sincerely apologize for the issues you encountered during your stay. We understand how important first impressions are, and it is disappointing to hear about the full trash cans and unemptied dishwasher. We will address these matters with our cleaning team to ensure this does not happen in the future. We are sorry to hear about the disturbances from the neighbors and hope that the situation was resolved quickly after your 911 call. Additionally, we will look into the icemaker malfunction and the availability of chair pads to ensure these are addressed for future guests. As for the pool, it is indeed heated at an additional cost, and we appreciate you noting that. We are glad that despite these issues, you were still able to have a pretty good time. Thank you for staying with us, and we hope to host you again in the future. Sincerely, Benchmark Management
